confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors rest on several 2025-2026 Cairo sources with mixed dates and wide venue spreads, so they are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine_glass are weakly sourced: cocktail rests on one 2025 downtown-club figure plus older bar ranges, and wine_glass is a rough estimate scaled from the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not from live listings or searches. The FX value is the 15 Oct 2026 RBA observation as surfaced by search of the rba.gov.au overview page; I did not re-open that page, and an aggregator showed 0.6947 for 16 Oct that I could not verify.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are anchored to Cairo-specific price observations (general cost-of-living sites and a July 2026 Spanish price guide that lists local beer and cappuccino at about 80 and 77 EGP). Cocktail and wine use the local beer relationship where direct data is weak. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cairo's hostel and hotel market.
